notes: Two player teams fighting hand-to-hand over a fortified town is Action by the boundary rule — a shared clash space rather than firing corridors, and torches are melee — with Strategy named second because the defenders are holding a base whose destruction is the win condition. Took Strategy's Base Defense preset for that reason but swapped its terrain-open shape for space-bounded, since the answers ask for a compact match area of a handful of buildings inside the grey wall rather than open contested ground, and dropped spawner-npc because the attackers are players, not AI waves. tracker-core is the town itself as the visible health pool the round is scored on, destructible-cluster the meltable ice buildings and wall, and choke-bottleneck the gates and breaches the rush funnels through. Nothing said the ice buildings are entered, so I kept them as exterior geometry and stayed off P3, and I assumed opposing start points outside and inside the wall for the round structure the answers describe.
